meta.purpose: Per-athlete one-time measurements the VALD DynaMo API does not capture. Feeds the body-mass-normalized peak-torque metric (torque = peak force N x lever arm m). Joined to VALD data by athlete name.
meta.forearmMethod: Floor to the middle of the DynaMo pad, measured in inches, in the locked test position. Serves as the ER/IR lever arm.
meta.note: Confirm the elbow/rotation axis sits at the floor reference for this to be a true moment arm. The ER:IR ratio does NOT depend on it (lever arm cancels); only the absolute torque normalization does.
